statement: The first line holds n and k; the second holds n bits. Print the length of the longest contiguous run of 1s obtainable by flipping at most k 0s. Keep a window containing at most k zeros: advance the right end each step, counting zeros that enter; while the count exceeds k, advance the left end, decrementing the count whenever a 0 leaves. The widest window seen is the answer - nothing is actually flipped.

example.why: Flipping the zeros at indices 5 and 10 makes the final six positions all 1.

hint: The budget is spent by zeros inside the window; ones are free and extend it for nothing.
mistake: Resetting the window to empty when a zero too many enters; slide the left end instead.
